experiments.rationale: Reduce previous Transformer overfitting; smaller LR, stronger head regularization/weight decay, mix clean and augmented samples; increase training budget for lower learning rate.

Round 1 CNN improved but BiLSTM regressed; neutral/weak classes motivated train-only inverse-frequency class weights, mild label smoothing and smaller-LR warm-start refinement. Parallel workers change execution only; numerical equivalence tested.
Transformer training/validation gap persists; lower LR to 1e-4 and increase augmented fraction to 75%. Roll BiLSTM back to original validation-best checkpoint rather than compound round 1 regression.

Revert augmentation to 50% for the stronger CNN/Transformer branches; increase label smoothing and weight decay to address high train confidence and persistent validation gap while retaining best BiLSTM weights.

Return to less aggressive regularization near round 2; local small-LR refinement. Temper inverse-frequency weights with square root to reduce overcorrection of the minority neutral class. Keep all prior best checkpoints.
